overview: The School Committee voted to opt out of the state's school choice program for the upcoming year and authorized a comprehensive assessment of transition services for students with disabilities. Members also discussed a significant deed restriction impacting the new high school project and highlights from the district's vocational programs.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved various items including payroll, budget transfers, and meeting minutes, as well as a 2027 world language trip to France and Italy.

items.title: Mustang Moment: Career Technical Education
items.summary: Superintendent and staff highlighted student achievements in electrical, biotechnology, and health assisting programs, noting high certification pass rates and union placements.

items.title: School Choice Participation 2026-2027
items.summary: Approved the recommendation to remain a no-school-choice district to maintain resources and instructional focus for Medford residents.

items.title: 2026-2027 Meeting Schedule
items.summary: Approved the meeting calendar with an amendment to include an additional meeting on June 14, 2027.

items.title: Medford Public Schools Handbooks
items.summary: Tabled approval of the 2026-2027 handbooks to June 8 to address concerns regarding inconsistent attendance policies, the use of recess as a punishment, and the inclusion of private addresses.

items.title: Restraint Policy and Bullying Prevention Plan
items.summary: Approved updated language for the district's bullying prevention plan and restraint policy to align with new state regulations and civil rights criteria.

items.title: MSBA Project Update
items.summary: Discussed MSBA feedback on the high school educational plan and a recently discovered 999-year deed restriction on parts of the site that may require an Article 97 legislative process or design revisions.

items.title: Project Transition Program Resolution
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting a comprehensive assessment of the Project Transition program to improve community-based work experiences and post-exit employment outcomes for students with disabilities.
